A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same GDPO research. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices A–F are readable and support comparison; the changed formatting does not indicate missing material.

before.justification: v2 reports original GDPO benchmark results, ELBO-estimator experiments, computational-cost measurements, and ablations in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains original GDPO benchmark and estimator results, appendix comparisons and ablations, and reports revised training-reward curves.

M1.justification: The importance weight below Eq. (6) changes from L_ELBO/L_ELBO_old to exp(L_ELBO)/exp(L_ELBO_old). These inequivalent definitions materially change the specified core update and clipping behavior. SDMC and Algorithm 1 otherwise remain unchanged; the PDFs do not establish whether the implementation also changed.

E1.justification: Both retain OpenWeb estimator experiments, GSM8K, MATH500, Countdown, Sudoku, HumanEval, MBPP, and KodCode-Light-RL-10K training. No additional dataset, domain, or distinct task scenario is documented.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same baselines: LLaDA-8B-Instruct, diffu-GRPO, SFT+diffu-GRPO, wD1, and coupled-GRPO where previously included. The added GSPO citation does not introduce an evaluated comparator.

E3.justification: Table 2 and Section 4.1 change the mathematics/planning condition from explicitly SFT-free GDPO to SFT+GDPO after a few supervised fine-tuning epochs. This substantially revises the reported training pipeline. The identical scores do not establish that experiments were rerun; generation lengths and tabulated hyperparameters remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Figure 5 revises the training-dynamics evidence concerning reward growth and plateauing for four tasks. The estimator comparison, quadrature-point ablation, computational-cost analysis, and Appendix F case studies are otherwise retained without new analytical questions.

E5.justification: Both report 16 estimator repetitions in Section 3.3 and the same mean ± SD reporting in Figure 2. No new seed counts, confidence intervals, significance tests, or uncertainty-estimation procedures accompany the revised reward curves.

E6.justification: Figure 5 replaces the GSM8K, Math, Countdown, and Sudoku reward trajectories and changes several training-step ranges; the KodCode curve is retained. Tabulated scores and Figures 1–4 are unchanged. The revised curves and SFT attribution do not establish same-setting performance improvements.

T1.justification: The mathematical definition of the importance ratio below Eq. (6) is corrected by exponentiating the ELBOs. The variance decomposition, asymptotic bounds, integrand properties, assumptions, and proofs in Appendices A–C remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same headline contributions: sequence-level GDPO with SDMC estimation, provable variance reduction, and improvements over checkpoints and strong baselines across reasoning and coding benchmarks.

C2.justification: Section 4.1 removes the interpretation that Table 2 demonstrates standalone GDPO superiority without costly SFT, replacing it with performance after SFT. Coding's no-SFT interpretation, the variance mechanism, longer-sequence explanation, and existing theoretical qualifications remain.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 replaces task-specific GPU exceptions with a statement about two-H100 training and optional eight-H100 acceleration; the appendix GPU allocations remain unchanged. v3 also identifies CoreWeave as the compute provider. Codebase, LoRA, optimizer, and other tabulated implementation details are retained.

R1.justification: v3 adds Zheng et al. (2025), Group Sequence Policy Optimization, and explicitly relates GDPO to GSPO in Section 3.3. v2 already mentioned GSPO without this citation. Other research positioning and cited comparator discussions remain unchanged.

P1.justification: Most prose is retained. Local edits revise the SFT and hardware paragraphs, add the GSPO sentence, acknowledgments, and an LLM-use statement. Appendix D is reordered from rewards/ablations/training to training/rewards/ablations.

P2.justification: The conference template changes typography, page geometry, headings, table formatting, and float placement throughout. Appendix tables are reordered and reformatted, while Figure 5 is redrawn with reordered panels and changed axes. Figures 1–4 and the sample-generation displays retain their underlying content.

improvement.justification: v3 improves mathematical consistency through the exponential importance ratio and improves transparency by correcting Table 2's SFT attribution and removing the associated SFT-free interpretation. These are useful repairs, but the SFT recipe remains underspecified and the revised reward curves are unexplained, limiting the overall gain in reproducibility and evidential clarity.
